sp500.note: SPEC CORRECTION. The project CLAUDE.md states 'data from row 4'. Verified WRONG by direct inspection: row 1 blank, row 2 human header (Entity Name / Entity ID / Ticker / Sector / Industry Group / Industry / Primary Industry), row 3 CapIQ field codes (SP_ENTITY_NAME ...), rows 4-5 blank, DATA STARTS ROW 6. All indices here are 1-based. Note also that build_sp100_dashboard.py:68 uses rows[4:] for SP100.xlsx, which has a DIFFERENT preamble - offsets are per-file and must never be hardcoded as a shared constant.

hwnet_companion.role: bellwether and industry curation only - NOT a price source
hwnet_companion.note: Column order differs from sp500: market cap sits at column 3 and ticker at column 4. Another reason mapping layout is per-source config.

rollup.note: minMembers is the n>=3 rule ported from SP100. A group with fewer than 3 full-history members gets comp:null, regime:'insufficient-sample' and a human-readable note - it is never given a fabricated composite. This is the 'never fabricate' rule in miniature and is enforced server-side, not in the client.

groupRegimes.note: This is the COARSE per-group classifier ported from build_sp100_dashboard.py:205 (classify_group_regime), deliberately distinct from the 8-state RenMac regime ladder in parameters.json. Each group is classified off its OWN equal-weight sub-composite, independent of the market-wide call. The vocabulary is bidirectional by design - bottoming and uptrend are first-class states, not a bearish-only read.

_unmappedNote: Every priced ticker must either resolve to a sector/industry group or be explicitly reported as unmapped. No silent drops from breadth or leadership rollups. Verified 500/500 mapped on the 2026-08-09 vintage.
